correctness.rationale: The specified Paley tournament has Q={1,3,4,5,9}; its eleven out-neighborhood facets form a 2-(11,5,2) biplane. Independent complete enumeration yields face vector (11,55,110,55,11), 110 valid greedy Morse pairs, 715 acyclic full Hasse covers, and exactly one critical vertex plus 21 critical 2-cells. Forman yields integral wedge of 21 two-spheres. Independently computed signed simplicial traces over all 55 affine maps give 21 at identity, -1 for 10 nonidentity translations, +1 for 44 multiplier elements. Semisimplicity and rational cyclotomic-character equality imply 1⊕2W (dimension 21). Only the fixed finite graph, not any infinite generalization, is proved.
